item.title: Naked Wines: “The best of Naked Wines is still ahead” states CEO, AGM Update next week could convince investors that the shares are a Buy
item.summary: On Thursday, 3rd September, Naked Wines (LON:WINE) will be holding its 2026 Trading Year’s AGM to approve its Report & Accounts. With a base of some 480,000 members, Naked Wines is all about connecting wine drinkers and winemakers. Its model removes the middlemen, so customers get better wine for their money and winemakers earn more for doing what they do best, […] The post Naked Wines: “The best of Naked Wines is still ahead” states CEO, AGM Update next week could convince investors that the shares are a Buy appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
